name: Iron Mountain trailhead / Poway Rd Park and Ride lot on Hwy 67 (free)
basis: Mountain Project Poway Crags 'Getting There': 'Park just South of Poway road on the 67. Take the very popular hikers trail up toward Iron Mountain' (fork at 1.5 mi, left toward Ramona Overlook, then north to the crag); a second guide says parking is free but fills on weekends. Road check: Route 67 segments pass 0.07 km from this lot, Poway Road junction ~0.1-0.2 km; the Iron Mountain trailhead node is 0.05 km away. Named 'Poway Road Park And Ride', access yes, no fee, 116 spaces. ~2.8 km from the crag coordinate.
